units.source_text: 这个房间里装有地炉，打开拉门，一股很强的热气便扑面而来。

en.t: There was a sunken hearth in this room, and when the sliding door was opened, a powerful wave of heat rushed into my face.

units.source_text: 我站在门槛边踟蹰不前。

en.t: I stood hesitating at the threshold, unable to step forward.

units.source_text: 只见一位老大爷盘腿坐在炉边。

en.t: I saw an old man sitting cross-legged beside the hearth.

units.source_text: 他浑身青肿，活像个溺死的人。

en.t: His whole body was bluish and swollen, just like someone who had drowned.

units.source_text: 他那两只连瞳孔都黄浊的、像是腐烂了的眼睛，倦怠地朝我这边瞧着。

en.t: His eyes, yellow and cloudy even in the pupils, as if they had begun to rot, looked wearily in my direction.

units.source_text: 身边的旧信和纸袋堆积如山。

en.t: Old letters and paper bags were piled up like mountains around him.

units.source_text: 说他是被埋在这些故纸堆里，也不过分。

en.t: It would not have been an exaggeration to say that he was buried in those heaps of old paper.

units.source_text: 我呆呆地只顾望着这个山中怪物，怎么也想象不出他还是个活人。

en.t: I could only stare blankly at this mountain creature, unable to imagine no matter how I tried that he was still a living person.
